name: Hairpin & Necklace
description: Forbidden City Ornament, as a wearable metal assembly model toy, is a creative innovation of Pinku. Pinku's exquisite ancient ornament prototype is designed in a 1:1 wearable size. It embodies the majestic charm of the Forbidden City and is decorated with gorgeous carvings, red walls and gold tiles, flying flowers and butterflies. These five ornaments bloom, one step at a time, to capture the beauty of the palace. |
